| elder/eldership | Elder/eldership | Elder/eldership / elder/eldership / Saptuam makaite, tuucing. Pawlpi sung kalsuanna khempeuh limtak a encikpa, pawlpi a kempa, leh a cingpa hi. Hih pen tuucing, pastor, siampite hi. Greek presbyteros, ‘presbyter, elder’ makaipi, a vanpi, cihna hi in, Greek episkopos, ‘bishop’ leh poimen ‘pastor’ tuucing tawh kizangkhawm hi. Tua ahih manin Manglai a elder, bishop leh pastor cihte kammal kilamdang taleh ‘a nasep kibang’ hi. Pawlpi pawlkhat in elder leh bishop kilamdangsak in, elder niamsak in bishop sangsak zaw a, bishop pen tuucing mun ah, pastor ah, koih uhhi. Makaipi dinmun, elder, pen Paul in Timoti tungah limtak in gen hi (1Tim.3:1-7). Titu tungah zong Paul in na genthuah leuleu hi (Tit.1:5-9). Pawlpi sunga makaipi, elder/pastor in mawhpuakna lian mahmah nam 4: hilhna, makaihna, thungetsakna leh kepcingna, hi. | C2 |

| elements | Elements | Elements / Nekkhawm sunga kihel nate. Saptuam tungah sep leh zuih dinga hong kisawl thu nih sung pan khat hi a, hih in Topa Nitak Ankuang tawh kizom in, tua sunga van leh nate, moh leh lenggah tui genna hi. Zeisu in galte khutsung a tunma in nungzuite tawh nitak ankuang umkhawm a, moh la in hih in ka sa leh ka pumpi hi, ci hi. Moh in Zeisu pumpi a genna hi a, Zeisu pumpi taktak suaklo banah Zeisu ci leh sa kihello hi. Zeisu in hai la in, cih pen, lenggah tui a lakna hi a, note a dinga kibuakhia ka sisan hi, ci hi. Hih hun in Zeisu si nailo ahih manin lenggah tui pen Zeisu sisan lim bek hi. Tuni in Nekkhawm i nek ciangin lenggah tui pen Zeisu sisan tawh kilaih lo banah lenggah tui sungah Zeisu sisan kihello hi. Zeisu sisan leh pumpi in a sihna tawh beisuak a, moh leh lenggah tui sungah kihel theilo hi. Tua banah kilaihna zong omlo hi. Nekkhawm i nek ciangin, Pasian itna leh Zeisu hotkhiatna hanga kingah thuphate kiphawk phasan ahih manin nekkhawm ah Pasian thupha, khalam thupha, om hi. Mihingte in Pasian i phawk theihna pen Pasian hehpihna hi a, tua in Pasian thupha hi. / elements | C2 |

| epistemology | epistemology | epistemology / Kantelna. Mihing ngaihsutna tuamtuam tungtawn a theihna thu sutna hi. Theihna, Greek episteme, knowledge, pen theihna thu sutna hi in, diksakna, kipatna leh theihna bangzah in kiciangtan cih zong lak hi. Hih thu ah theihna i cih bang hiam! Bang kithei ding hiam! Bang kithei theilo ding hiam! Theihna koi ci ngah ding! Bang in theihna maan piangsak hiam cih ngaihsutna hi. Upna thu ah Pasian thu leh Pasian omna koi cibang a kithei thei hiam cih ahi hi. Pasian omna pen a piansaksa nate hangin, cosmological argument, kithei thei hi. Pasian pen bang cibang a kithei thei ding i cih ciangin ama hong kilaakna bek tawh kithei thei hi. Ahi zongin kilaakna, Laisiangtho bek, simlo in khuak theihna, mihingte theihna tungtawn in Pasian omzia kithei hi, cih zong upna hi. A maan leh a maanlo khentelna hi. / Epistemology | C2 |

| forensic | Forensic | giitloh saat lohna-a kizangh vante a sawtpi nunga kankhiatna lam tawh kisai / Forensic / Thukhun tawh kizui a dikna. Hotkhiatna thu tawh kizom a, thukhun tawh kizui a diksakna hi. Diktansakna pen mihingte sep hilo in Pasian in dik hi, siangtho hi, ci a hong tangkona leh kipsakna hi. Gamtat hoihna hang hilo in Pasian dikna leh itna eite tungah hong kilawh manin Pasian mai ah dikna kingah hi. Abraham in sepna tawh dikkisakna ngahlo in a upna pen Pasian in dikna in ciamteh hi. Upna kihello in Pasian mai ah dikkisakna ngahna ding lampi omlo hi. Leitung mite sung pan a sia pen ihih hangin Pasian in upna i neih zawh teh dikna hong pia in, siangtho teh, dik teh hong ci hi. Pasian in hong diksak a, mihingte sepna tawh dikna leh sianthona kingah theilo hi. | C2 |

| glossolalia | Glossolalia | Glossolalia / Pautuamte. Greek glossa ‘tongue’ ; laleo, ‘to speak’, genkhia, pau cihna hi a, Khasiangtho letsongte sungah khat hi. Piangthakte sungah a kibuaipih leh pawlpi hong kikhensak kammal hi. Buaina khat pen tulai mite kampau dan maw, ahih keileh a kitheilo ahi bualbual maw, cih bangin ngaihsutna tuamtuam om hi. Pentecost Ni in Sawltakte in a kithei paute, known languages, pau-te a, Aramaic pau a theilote in lunglut mahmah hi (Sawl.2:5-13). Paul ngaihsutna ah pautuam pauna pen mihing tunga kigen hilo in Pasian tunga kigen leh kipau hizaw ahih manin ‘kuamah in a khiatna theilo hi’ (1Kor.14:2). Paul ngaihsutna ah pautuam pen midangte theih dingin kilet ding, kamphen om ding hi, ci hi (1Kor.14:5, 27-28). Pentecostalte (AGte) in kamtuam pauna in pianthakna lak hi. A piangthakte in kamtuam pau zatloh phamawhsak in sinlai uhhi. Kamtuam pauna pen Khasiangtho ngahna tawh kizom hi. Pianthak khit hun khat ciangin Khasiangtho khuanung tun ci a, Khasiangtho ngahna dingin thu nakpi in ngen in kamtuam pau zong kisinsak uhhi. Mi khat a pianthak leh kamtuam pau pau ding ci hi. Ahi zongin Tuiphumte in kamtuam pen niallo in pautuam hizaw hi, ci hi. A khiatna a khia thei ding mi 2 kisam ahih manin hih pen a kitello ahi bualbualte hilo ding hi. Laisiangtho kicingta ahih manin pautuam kisam nawnlo a, pawlpi kipna dingin Pasian in ama kammal bek zang hi. Pautuam leh kamtuam khiatna kilamdang mahmah hi. / glossolalia | C2 |

| hamartia | Hamartia, hamartia | Hamartia / hamartia / Hih ding pen hih khalo. Mawhna thu hilhciatna ah kammal thupi pen khat hi in mawhna pen hih ding pen hih khalo a, hih loh ding pen hihkhakna hi. Mawhna pen Pasian hong deih banga nuntak lohna leh Pasian hong lamet banga nuntak lohna hi. Pasian thukham palsatna in mawhna hi (Lk.5:21; Jn.16:8; Rom 6:23; Heb.9:28). | C2 |
| hamartialogy | hamartialogy | hamartialogy / Mawhna thu sutna. Mawhna thu sutna in Pasian thugilte sungah khat hi. Mawhna pen Pasian thupiakte leh Pasian thukhamte tawh kituak a nuntak zawh lohna hi. Mawhna pen Pasian deih banga nuntak lohna hi. A diklo khempeuh mawhna hi. Mi khempeuh Pasian mai ah mawhcip hi. Mawhna thaman in sihna hi. Mawhna in Pasian tawh hong kikhensak hi. Pasian tawh a kikhente si hi. Sihna pen kha sihna, tawntung sihna leh pumpi sihna hi. Mawhna hangin leitung ah gentheihna namkim om in kithuak hi. Naupangte zong Pasian muhna ah mawhnei ahih manin a mawhsa in nu sung pan suakkhia hi. A mawhcip mihingte in hotkhiatna kisam hi. Zeisu bek in hong honkhia thei hi. Hotkhiatna ngahte in vantung gam tung ding hi. / Hamartialogy | C2 |

| heilsgeschichte | Heilsgeschichte | Hotkhiatna tangthu. German, ‘heil- salvation, geschichte- history’ history of salvation, pen Pasian in Israelte a hotkhiatna leh thuzuite a hotkhiatna thu sutna hi. Hih kammal pen kum zalom 20 hun in kizang hi. Pasian thugil sutna bek hilo in Pasian pianngei leh Pasian nasepte genna ah kizang hi. Israelte Izipt pan a ciahkikna leh Zeisu in hong hotkhiatna thu pen tangthu mawkmawk hilo in hotkhiatna thu laigil taktak leh mite nuntakna a kilamdangsak tangthu hing ahihna lahna hi. Hotkhiatna pen Pasian nasepte tungtawn in kimu hi. Israelte tangthu in Pasian hong itna leh hotkhiatna thu hong lakkhol in singlamteh tungah Zeisu in sihna hong thuak ciangin Pasian nasepte a taktak ahihna kilang semsem hi. / Heilsgeschichte / heilsgeschichte | C2 |

| ordinances | Ordinances | Ordinances / Pawlpi zuih ding thunih. Cituamna lahna dinga Zeisu in pawlpi tungah sep leh bawl dinga hong sawl lim nihte hi. Khat pen Tuiphumna hi in, a dang khat pen Nekkhawm hi. Hotkhiatna ngahna ding hilo in upna tawh Pasian ta suahna lahna hi. RC in sacraments cih kammal tawh upna zungpi 7 nei a, hihte pen hotkhiatna ngahna dingin zui uhhi. Tuiphumna pen Zeisu tawh sihkhopna leh sihna pan thawhkikna, Pasian mite tawh kipumkhatna banah Pasian tawh kipumkhatna lahna hi. A piangthakte in Pa min, Tapa min leh Khasiangtho min tawh tui kiphum ding hi (Mt.28:19-20). Hih in Zeisu thupiak hi. Nekkhawm, Topa Nitak Ankuang, pen updan tuamtuam om hi. Zeisu in na bawl un hong ci ahih manin bawl ding hi. RC upna ah siampite in moh leh lenggah tui thupha a piakkhit ciangin Zeisu pumpi leh sisan tawh kilaih hi (transubstantiation). Lutherante upna ah siampite in moh leh lenggah tui thupha a piakkhit ciangin Zeisu pumpi leh sisan kihel hi (consubstantiation). Reformedte in nekkhawm ah khalam thupha om ci hi. Tui kiphumte in Zeisu hong sepsaksa thute phawkna ciang tawh kibawl hi. Hih pen Zwingli tung pan kiluahsuk hi. Nekkhawm i zat ciangin Pasian itna leh Zeisu thuakna kiphawk ahih manin Khalam thupha om takpi cih kimu hi. / ordinances | C2 |

| protoevangelium | protoevangelium | protoevangelium / Lungdamna thu a masa bel tangkona. Leitung ah mawhna hong lut ciangin Pasian in mawhneite kihotkhiatna ding lungdamna thu tangkona na neipah a, tua pen Piancilna 3:15 hi. Hih in a masa pen lungdamna thu tangkona hi. Pasian in a bawlsa mihingte it mahmah ahih manin mawhna pan a honkhia ding, honkhiapa Zeisu, hong paisakna ding hih mun ah tangko hi. Leitung ah Zeisu mihing banga hong paina pen Pasian in tangtawng a kipan a gelsa hi in (Efe.1:4), Zeisu in a mangte a zong ding leh a honkhia dingin hong pai in (Lk.19:10), mawhneite tang dingin sihna hong thuak in (Rom 5:8), a sep ding khempeuh zosiang hi (Jn.19:30). Sih dongin thumaan a, sihna in len zolo in thokik in vantung ah kahto a, Pa ziatlam ah eite a dingin thu hong ngetsak hi. / Protoevangelium | C2 |

Mi khat in Zeisu a up ciangin Pasian muhna ah misiangtho leh midik suak hi (1Kor.1:2). A piangthak khempeuh Pasian muhna ah kibang in siangtho hi. Ahi zongin nasepna ah numei leh pasal sep ding kilamdangsak hi. Saptuam makaih dingin pasal bek Pasian in deih hi (1Tim.3:1-7). | sex/sexuality | sex/sexuality | sex/sexuality / Numei leh pasal omkhopna. Mihingte sungah numei leh pasal omkhopna, kizopna bek hilo in ganhingte sungah zong a nu leh a pate in khuahun zui in kizopna nei hi. Pasian pen kha ahih manin hih mihingte nopsak mahmah nupa kizopna neilo hi. Pasian in mihingte numei leh pasal in piangsak a, hih numei leh pasal omkhopna bawlsak hi, phal hi. Numei leh pasal kizopna pen Pasian piak hi. Leitung ah Adam leh Eve bek om ding deihlo ahih manin Pasian in mi tampi om ding deih a, numei leh pasal, nupa kitenna, tawh ta tampi neih ding thupha pia hi (Pian.1:28). Numei leh pasal omkhopna pen Pasian patkhiat ahih mah bangin (1) Zi leh pasal bek omkhopna leh kizopna hi dinga, khuavalna tawh hilo ding hi. (2) Nupa omkhopna kizopna pen nopsak mahmahna ding, lungsim leh pumpi kigawmkhop semsemna ding, kihehnepna ding, kipumkhatna ding, khanna ding leh khuavalna tawh gamtatna ding pan kidalna hi. Kiten khit ciangin, nupa suahkhit ciangin, nupa omkhopna leh kizopna pen Pasian minthanna dinga zat ding hi. Nupa kizahtakna ding leh kithupi bawlna dinga zat ding hi. / Sex/sexuality | C2 |

| theocentric | Theocentric, Pasian bulphuh | Theocentric / Pasian bulphuh / Pasian bulphuh. Na khempeuh ah a nungta Pasian leh a kammal tungah kingakna hi. Tapidaw nuntakna ah i kingakna ding leh i bulphuh ding Pasian leh a kammal bek om a, mipilte theihna, mihingte ngeina leh mi khat genkholhna tawh kalsuanna hilo hi. Pasian a bulphuh nuntakna bek mannei hi. Mihingte khuak tunga kingakna kiplo a, Pasian kammal tunga dinna bek kip hi. | C2 |
| theocentricity | Theocentricity | Theocentricity / Pasian tung bek ah kingakna. Pasian tung bek ah kingakna in a gilpen leh a thupi pen hi. Vai khempeuh ah Pasian deihna zui a, Pasian deihlohte pelh a, Pasian sawlna banga gamtatna hi. Mihingte tungah kingakna in milim biakna suak a, Pasian in ama tunga kingate lamsang hi. Tapidaw upna pen mihing khensatna leh hoihna tungah kinga lo in Pasian thahatna leh Pasian sepna tungah kinga hi. Hotkhiatna ngahna dingin mihingte in sep ding omlo a, Pasian in hong sepsaksa vive hi. Mawhneite in hotkhiatna ngahna dingin bangmah sem theilo hi. Pasian tungah upna lam ding hi. I vai khempeuh Pasian tungah ap ding hi. / theocentricity | C2 |

Sawltakte hun leh Pentecost hun a kizang pau pen mihingte in amau pau bangin za ahih manin a kithei thei pau nam khat hi. A kithei theilo pau hileh a khiatna kigen theilo dinga, mite kha nuntakna ah thupha piangsak lo ding hi. Zomite in ‘kamtuam’ i cih ciangin ahi bualbual dingin kingaihsunpah a, pautuam kici leh mihingte pau tawh kibang leh kihuang ahihna kithei dinga, khialhna tawm zawdeuh ding hi. Kamtuam cih ding hilo in pautuam hizaw hi. Hih thu ah Tuiphumte leh Pentecostalte kilamdang hi. / Tongues | C2 |
